# Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago Collection of projects for connecting HuniePop 2:Double Date with Archipelago # Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago Client Built using template from https://github.com/alwaysintreble/ArchipelagoBepInExPluginTemplate Requires Hunie Pop 2 APWorld to generate a world A BepInEx plugin for Hunie Pop 2 to connect and talk to a Archipelago server for multiworld randomization games BACKUP YOUR SAVE FILE BEFORE USING THIS AS I CANT GUARANTEE THAT IT WILL NOT CORRUPT IT (also is a good idea to back up your saves when modding any game) - Windows save location: "C:/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/AppData/LocalLow/HuniePot/HuniePop 2 - Double Date/" - Mac save location: "/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/Library/Application Support/com.HuniePot.HuniePop2-DoubleDate/" INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - Have Hunie Pop 2 Installed - Download Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago plugin (See Releases for latest version) - Extract and copy the contents of "Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago plugin.zip" to the directory where "HuniePop 2 - Double Date.exe" is # Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago APWorld APWorld For Hunie Pop 2:Double Date Tutorials for setting up and starting a Archipelago world/server https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/ BACKUP YOUR SAVE FILE BEFORE USING THIS AS I CANT GUARANTEE THAT IT WILL NOT CORRUPT IT (also is a good idea to back up your saves when modding any game) - Windows save location: "C:/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/AppData/LocalLow/HuniePot/HuniePop 2 - Double Date/" - Mac save location: "/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/Library/Application Support/com.HuniePot.HuniePop2-DoubleDate/" Note items are processed when moving between locations
F8 will bring up a console to interact with AP server and view logs Locations checked: - progressing the pair to attracted/lovers (2 per pair, 24 in total) - all questions that give a favorite answer (20 per girl, 240 in total) (CAN BE DISABLED IN OPTIONS) - giving each girls unique/shoe gift (4 unique, 4 shoe per girl, 48 total) - Archipelago shop items (number depends on options you setup the game with, generation may add shop locations to satisfy the location requirement for the APWorld) (CAN BE CONFIGURED IN OPTIONS) - unlocking outfits though dates(5 per girl, 60 total) (CAN BE DISABLED IN OPTIONS) - beating the nymphojinn will release all items items implemented: (Note you start with 2 pairs and 4 girls unlocked) - unlock condition for each girl (12 total) (Note you must also have unlocked one of the pairs attached to the girl to interact with her) - unlock condition for each pair(24 total) (Note must have both girls unlocked to access the pair) - unique/shoe gifts (4 unique, 4 shoe per girl, 48 total) (Note if your inventory is full the item will be in limbo until there is space, ALSO once a gift is gotten it can be repurchased in the store) - fairy wings (24 in total) (Note you need all 24 of these to access the nymphojinn fight) - talent/romance/flirtation/sexual/passion/style token level up items (4 for talent/romance/flirtation/sexual, 8 for passion/style, 32 total) (Note you can not level up these any other way) - baggage for each girl (3 per girl, 36 total) - outfits (10 per girl, 120 total) (CAN BE DISABLED IN OPTIONS)

notes.text:
- (APWorld) Added options to set the min/max value for Food, Date Gifts, Girl Gifts and Arch Items in shop - (APWorld) Changed YMAL option "filler_item" from a number range to specific option choices - (APWorld) Changed Default Template option order so that relevant options are grouped together - (Client) Made Number of Items gotten on start screen properly reflect amount received - (Client) Fixed the last Arch Item in shop not being generated properly - (Client) Made Arch Items disappear from inventory after moving locations - (Client) Fixed random error in console on client start -----HOTFIX----- - (PopTracker) fix shoe gifts not auto tracking
BACKUP YOU ORIGINAL SAVE CANT GUARANTEE THAT IT WONT GET CORRUPTED Windows save location: "C:/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/AppData/LocalLow/HuniePot/HuniePop 2 - Double Date/" Mac save location: "/Users/{YOUR USERNAME}/Library/Application Support/com.HuniePot.HuniePop2-DoubleDate/" CLIENT INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - Have Hunie Pop 2 Installed - Download Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago plugin (See Releases for latest version) - Extract and copy the contents of "Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago plugin.zip" to the directory where "HuniePop 2 - Double Date.exe" is - play and connect to a Archipelago server APWORLD INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - Have Archipelago Launcher Installed (latest release found here: https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest ) - Download Huniepop 2 APWorld (See Releases for latest version) - Select "Install APWorld" in launcher and select Huniepop 2 APWorld you downloaded - Restart launcher for APWorld to properly install - (Optional but Recomended)Select "Generate Template Options" to generate default Huniepop 2 YMAL POPTRACKER INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS: - copy contents of "Hunie Pop 2 Archipelago PopTracker.zip" into the packs folder in the poptracker install directory
